title: Complaint references and follow-up - support procedure
content: For a synthetic case, use the agent queue to inspect Open, Needs Follow-up, Escalated Further or Resolved status. Only permitted non-sensitive information should be added; real escalation deadlines must be confirmed with the responsible institution.
